correctness.rationale: The icosahedral simplicial boundary has 12 vertices,30 edges,20 triangles and 4096 induced vertex subsets. Independent enumeration found 1758 subsets with nonzero reduced H0 or H1 and reproduced every q0/q1 chain dimension exactly. An independently constructed integer q0 subset-poset differential in explicit component-difference bases satisfies delta²=0 and is completely exhausted by unimodular ±1 pivots, with ranks (35,125,190,100,12) at subset sizes 2..6 and zero at 7. Combinatorial Alexander duality for induced subcomplexes in S², complementing vertex sets, identifies the q1 cochain system as the transpose dual and gives reverse ranks (12,100,190,125,35), preserving unit Smith factors. Hence both cohomology systems are torsion-free and have ranks 1,10,10,1 at the indicated interior bidegrees. Empty and full subcomplexes contribute rank1 each; total integral rank24. This is a complete finite proof of this one complex, with no extrapolation.
risks: The q1 integer computation uses Alexander duality and complement reverse inclusion; its identification is a topological theorem, not an independent 6504-map reconstruction.
Finite claim for one icosahedral boundary only; no general sphere-triangulation torsion theorem.
